'''Telleon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] foreman residing on [[Quesh]] around [[3642 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Telleon appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Quesh. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
